business_id.description: Stable ID from local source (e.g. Maps place_id)

primary_social_profile.description: Main social media profile link (e.g., LinkedIn or Facebook)

rating.description: Review rating (0 to 5) from maps source

review_count.description: Number of reviews on maps source

review_platforms.description: List of review platforms where this business is present (e.g., ['google', 'yelp'])

domain.description: The base domain extracted from the website URL

dns_records_summary.description: Summary of DNS records (A, MX, TXT)

tech_stack.description: Detected technologies on the website (e.g., WordPress, Shopify, Google Analytics)

online_presence_score.description: Computed score (0-100) representing strength of online profiles and website

review_health_score.description: Computed score (0-100) based on review rating, volume, and platform diversity

lead_quality_score.description: Deterministic scoring combining online presence, review health, domain age, and tech stack

source_actor_run_id.description: Run ID of the local-data maps actor

enriched_at.description: ISO timestamp when the enrichment occurred

location_query.description: Location query used to discover this lead

industry_keywords.description: Keywords used to discover this lead
